newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Koor most widely held by Israeli funds.
newsitem.headline: Koor most widely held by Israeli funds.

text.p: Koor Industries Ltd pushed aside Discount Investment Corp to become the stock most widely held by Israeli mutual funds in the third quarter, Meitav Securities and Investments said on Wednesday.
Its quarterly survey of mutual fund holdings showed the five biggest funds, which account for 89.3 percent of total mutual fund assets, held 148 million shekels of Koor stock at the end of September.
Israel Chemicals Ltd was second among the top five stocks, followed by IDB Development, Bezeq Israel Telecom and Discount Investment.
Meitav said Discount's fall to fifth place was mainly due to the 21 percent decline in its share price in the quarter, although it added that fund managers had also been sellers of the stock.

As measured by the percentage of a company's registered share capital held by funds, the venture capital fund Mofet was ranked first. Some 18.9 percent of Mofet's stock was in the hands of funds. Electra Ltd, Feuchwanger 5, Ytung and Clal Computers followed.
